content: {"episode_id":"ep-05015","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. The note indicates mobile cardiac telemetry for continuous rhythm assessment to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management."}
